name: Split Rocks parking lot at the end of the road north from Park Boulevard
basis: MP Split Rocks Getting There: driving east, turn left (north) 1.2 mi past Jumbo and park at the end of the cul-de-sac; SummitPost/Climbing.com agree. Road check: lot sits 0.03 km from Split Rock Trail, the only mapped road/trail end there; other candidate lots 0.4-0.55 km away.

name: Pinto Basin Road pullout 1.4 mi north of the Pinto Wye (Munchkinland)
basis: MP OZ Area Getting There: southern of two lots is a turnout 1.4 mi north of the Pinto Wye, accessing Munchkinland Area, No Place Like Dome, Voodoo Dome, Munchkinland Crag. Road check: lot is on the Park Boulevard segment, 2.3 km (1.45 mi) from the Wye; the other pullout at 1.9 km (1.2 mi) fits worse. Northern lot (1.7 mi) not in brief.
